Definition: probably neuter of G2304 (in its original sense of flashing); sulphur:--brimstone.
BiblicalUsage: Scripture uses theîon where it means brimstone, sulphur. In Luke 17:29, the same day that Lot went out of Sodom it rained fire and brimstone from heaven. The word turns up 7 times, and each time it points to the same reality.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this word keeps me honest about what Scripture actually teaches. That is why I come back to theîon whenever I need to remember what is true.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
